title: LoRA-Whisper: Parameter-Efficient and Extensible Multilingual ASR
read_scope: Read official ISCA metadata and abstract; methods 3.1-3.3, dataset/training 4.1-4.2, language-expansion results 4.3-4.5, tables 1-5 and conclusion. PDF is 5 pages. No code or experiment rerun.
key_evidence: Whisper-small, language-specific LoRA in encoder and decoder; LoRA warm start and LoRA MoE for new languages. FLEURS target-language training data ranges 7.4-12.2 h; existing-language donor data in MLS ranges 103-247 h. The paper already compares donor LoRA initialization and finds the most similar donor works best; wrong donor initialization can be worse than training the adapter from scratch. Reported 23% relative gain over full fine-tuning for warm start and 5% over recipient LoRA for MoE in its language-expansion setup.
